data.h1: M-200 Titanium Dioxide for Exterior Plastics and Masterbatch Evaluation

data.positioning_title: Where M-200 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning_paragraphs: M-200 is a chloride-process rutile titanium dioxide pigment treated with silica, alumina and organic compounds for exterior-plastics and masterbatch evaluation.

Use M-200 as a candidate when durability, processing behavior, powder conveying, compatibility, dispersion, color fastness and anti-chalking behavior are relevant. Final selection should account for polymer, carrier resin, additives, pigment loading, processing temperature, equipment, exposure conditions, appearance and destination documents.

data.applications_title: Exterior Plastics and Masterbatch Directions to Evaluate

applications.title: uPVC Profiles, Plates and Exterior Furniture
applications.text: Evaluate M-200 in the intended uPVC or exterior-plastic system. Confirm dispersion, appearance, processing behavior, outdoor-performance requirements and end-use suitability.

applications.title: PVC Calendered Films, Including Advertising Film
applications.text: Test M-200 at the intended pigment loading, formulation and calendering conditions. Review compatibility, dispersion, color, processing behavior and finished-film performance.

applications.title: Durable Plastic Masterbatch
applications.text: Evaluate M-200 in the selected carrier resin and dilution system. Confirm powder handling, dispersion, color development, processing and performance in the final plastic application.
